name: Shotgun
summary: The quarterback five yards deep with a back on each side of him and the slot just outside the tight end. A passing look: the quarterback sees the field and has room to throw before anybody reaches him.
personnel: 11 players, 2 tight ends, quarterback, 2 backs, 1 slot
notes: Both ends are tight on the line and the slot is just outside the tight end, one step off the line, which keeps seven on the line. The quarterback takes the snap five yards deep, and the two backs stand level with him, two yards either side, where they can step up and pick up the rush. The 3-back is the tailback (odd holes) and the 2-back is the fullback (even holes). The call names the slot's side every time — Slot Right or Slot Left.
